answer: A falcon doesn't hunt by counting feathers, it watches how the bird actually flies. The same trick works against sybils: instead of trusting a pile of fresh identities, the network scores each agent on the work it has done over time, like a river carving a channel that can't be faked overnight. A new lotus account with no history gets throttled to small jobs only until it builds a real record. Copies are cheap, history isn't.
